entry.title: Messaging 1.35.34
entry.content: Messaging 1.35.34: a picture can be copied in one chat and pasted into another. Hold a picture in a text or Signal chat and choose Copy picture, then hold the message box of any chat and choose Paste. An empty message box now offers Paste too, for words as well as pictures

entry.title: Datebook 0.1.66
entry.content: Datebook 0.1.66: with week numbers on, the month has a line between the week numbers and the first day, the same as between days

entry.title: Atlas 0.1.9
entry.content: Atlas 0.1.9: in Settings, Navigation, miles or kilometers is now a choice between mph and km/h, side by side, in place of the Miles and feet switch; in Settings, Advanced, the row for opening links is in place when the page opens

entry.title: Messaging 1.35.33
entry.content: Messaging 1.35.33: the list of people in a new message is brought up to date when it opens, so someone just added in the contacts app is there

entry.title: Music Box 2.18.40

entry.title: Cabinet 0.9.14
entry.content: Cabinet 0.9.14: an app given a folder can ask where a file in it sits, so Music Box can save a song's details there; a file is no longer made or renamed before its name is checked

entry.title: Datebook 0.1.65
entry.content: Datebook 0.1.65: the reminder of an all-day event is set as a day and a time of day (on the day, the day before, two days or a week before, at any time); Settings has New all-day events remind; an evening reminder on the day is no longer dropped

entry.title: Atlas 0.1.8
entry.content: Atlas 0.1.8: the Settings rows Atlas does not have (3D buildings, mobile data, the log file, the profile) are hidden before a page opens, so none shows for a moment; the help file no longer has an entry about voice instructions
